notes: SUMMARY: Mid-market SaaS building a contextual knowledge assistant for enterprise customers. Evaluating hosted API first to validate UX, then want Dedicated in a VPC for production (data residency + isolation).
POC notes: used hosted API chat endpoint + embeddings for doc search pipeline. Seed dataset ~120k docs. Observed good relevance; recall ~0.82 on internal test set.
Performance ask: 95th percentile latency < 150ms for conversational queries; throughput target 150 rps during peak; want predictable tail latency for SLAs.
Cost sensitivity: target gross inference cost <= $0.10 / 1k generated tokens averaged across chat workload. Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations (batching + quantized model paths).
Model preference: prefer open-models compatible with Redwood (Llama-derivative or Falcon-family); want ability to pin versions and route fallbacks to smaller / cheaper variant under load.

Security: MUST have SSO (SAML) integration with Okta; SOC2 evidence required for Dedicated; audit logs and retention controls are gating items for procurement. Quote: 'We cannot go live without VPC peering + KMS-managed keys.'
Networking: ask for VPC peering diagram, egress restrictions, and support for private endpoints. On-prem option considered for a subset of clients but lower priority.
SE feedback from Priya: recommended Dedicated pool with 3 shard workers for predictable 99th pct latency; enable prefix caching for chat to reduce token cost on repeated prompts.

Outstanding security items: exportable audit logs (7+ years preferred by compliance), configurable retention policy per tenant, support for HSM/KMS key rotation, and data residency SLA for EU customers (they have EU enterprise customers).
Commercial: Lodestone asked for 3-month pilot rate and 12-month committed discount tiers. Running ARR planning for 2026; good chance to expand to enterprise seat if pilot succeeds.
Call paraphrase: 'We love the latency numbers on hosted, but we need the security story — SOC2 artifacts + SAML + audit trails — before we can sign up for Dedicated.'

Next actions owner: Jordan to push redlined DPA to Lodestone legal; Priya to compile Dedicated sizing + SOC2 evidence packet; Solutions eng to prepare VPC peering runbook and sample SAML metadata exchange steps.
